name: Nervous
description: Generic anxious/on-edge state. Apply with [state <char> -> nervous]. Layers anxiety and jitter onto the character; overlays append to existing anatomy prose.

properties.affect_summary: Nervous — on edge and second-guessing herself, anxious about how this goes. Words come a little fast or a little stuck; she's bracing for something to go wrong.
properties.mannerism_overlay: Fidgets with her hands or sleeves, glances at exits, laughs too quickly to fill silences, talks a touch fast, picks at a thumbnail.

body_overlays.head: Her eyes dart and won't quite settle, a tight uncertain set to her mouth; she keeps swallowing.
body_overlays.hands: Her hands won't stay still — fingers twisting together, picking at a nail, fidgeting with whatever's in reach.
